description: Worker cache-pressure eviction and artifact tmpfs staging operations. Exposes the pressure controller (disk-usage gauge, evictions/evicted-bytes by reason) and the RAM staging path (tmpfs reserved bytes, tmpfs->NVMe spill count/bytes, NVMe fallback by reason). All metrics use the static total label or the closed reason enum; asset/job/task identifiers, hashes and URLs remain out of Prometheus.

panels.title: Cache disk usage %
panels.description: Cache-root disk usage percent observed by the pressure controller (statfs on every tick). Hysteresis: eviction starts at HIGH (default 80%) and stops at LOW (default 72%).

panels.title: tmpfs reserved bytes
panels.description: RAM bytes currently reserved for ARTIFACT_STAGING tmpfs placements. Tracks the live reservation ledger: every reserve/release moves this gauge.

panels.title: Cache evictions by reason
panels.description: rate(velox_cache_evictions_total[5m]) grouped by reason. Closed reason enum: pressure, ttl, invalid, protected, leased, grace, in_flight, stale_snapshot, no_snapshot, error. A sustained pressure rate above zero means the cache root is over the high watermark.

panels.title: Cache evicted bytes (rate)
panels.description: rate(velox_cache_evicted_bytes_total[5m]) — physical bytes removed from the cache by pressure eviction and corruption invalidation. Bytes/s.

panels.title: NVMe fallback by reason
panels.description: rate(velox_artifact_nvme_fallback_total[5m]) grouped by reason. Closed reason enum: no_space, unknown_size, statfs_error, tmpfs_disabled, reservation_failed, other. A rising no_space/reservation_failed rate means RAM staging is over-committed for the current job mix.

panels.title: tmpfs spills (rate)
panels.description: rate(velox_artifact_tmpfs_spill_total[5m]) — artifacts spilled from tmpfs to durable NVMe (upload failure or graceful shutdown). Count/s.

panels.title: tmpfs spilled bytes (rate)
panels.description: rate(velox_artifact_tmpfs_spill_bytes_total[5m]) — bytes spilled from tmpfs to durable NVMe. Bytes/s.

options.content: This dashboard intentionally uses only the static `label=total` series (referenced by bare metric name) and the closed `reason` enum. Asset IDs, content hashes, job/task/attempt IDs, URLs and error details remain in the spool/read-model APIs, not Prometheus labels. Fallback and eviction reasons are a bounded set, so `sum by (reason)` stays low-cardinality.

title: Velox — Cache Pressure & Artifact Staging
